staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: subsidiary reputation within the MNE; autonomy and resources as moderators (survey scales)

theory: differentiated fit (contingency logic applied to the MNC)

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: extent and direction of knowledge flows by subsidiary strategic role; differentiated systems and processes

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: subsidiary autonomy; internal and external network range and strength

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: subsidiary role typology (world mandate, specialized contributor, local implementer); autonomy, value-chain configuration, internal product flows

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: coordinative versus entrepreneurial role; network embeddedness, internal position, autonomy

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: differentiated fit and shared values

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: balance of global efficiency, local responsiveness and worldwide learning; differentiated subsidiary roles

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: capability and charter change

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: adoption of an organizational practice under host-institutional and parent-relational pressure

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: differentiated fit of formal structure; shared values

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: internally differentiated network; resource configuration; internal power distribution

notes: Bridge to tension 2: interorganizational lens applied to one firm

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: typology of centres
main_finding_within_unit_differentiation: Abstract reports motivation only (subsidiary as node in an interorganizational network)

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: normative integration and communication
main_finding_within_unit_differentiation: Screening reason only: normative integration and communication at subsidiary level relate to innovation

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: organizational form

notes: Needs full text before any use

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: subsidiary contributory role, initiative, autonomy
main_finding_within_unit_differentiation: Resources plus initiative drive a contributory role; contributory role associated with autonomy and low local competition

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: subsidiary activities and relationships

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: subsidiary initiative; autonomy agreed with HQ
main_finding_within_unit_differentiation: Screening reason only

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: mandate gain and loss over time

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: configuration of international HRM strategies for integration and responsiveness
main_finding_within_unit_differentiation: Five configurations; firms pursue integration and responsiveness at once within the HRM function

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: IR pressures (economic, technological, political, customer, competitive) on businesses and functions; proposes a measurement methodology

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: integration, responsiveness and export orientation of subsidiary strategy (survey scales)
country_dyad_setting: subsidiaries in two Central and Eastern European economies
main_finding_within_unit_differentiation: Resource endowments, local competition and home-host distance shape responsiveness and exporting but affect integration only slightly

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: GI/LR balance; subsidiary management

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: IR grid; pressures for global integration and local responsiveness

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: review of organization theory schools

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: IR strategy groups (survey scales)

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: differentiation of subunit orientations and structure; integration and integrating devices

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: global pressures; subsidiary conduct (learning, networking, innovation); performance

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: tension between global competitive pressure and host-country demands

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: control and flexibility

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: split, shared, MNE-dominant and local-partner-dominant control over activities

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: structural configuration of parent control; informal mechanisms

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: management control and its antecedents

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: overall and specific control by foreign and local parent

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: control mechanism, focus and extent; innovation

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: successive inpatriation
main_finding_within_unit_differentiation: Successive inpatriation builds subsidiary capability; distinct from expatriation

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: expatriates as direct control (bears), socialization (bumble-bees), informal communication (spiders)
main_finding_within_unit_differentiation: Expatriates control subsidiaries through direct control, socialization and informal communication networks
notes: H1 mechanism vocabulary

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: transfer of managers; socialization-based control

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: knowledge acquisition from the foreign parent

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: geopolitical risk

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: responses to sanctions

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: WOS vs JV choice after Entity List designation

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: de-globalization

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: bifurcated governance; value chain decoupling

staffing_integration_construct_and_measu: diplomatic and corporate networks
